S5 E16 — MarriedRhonda uses her origami marriage predictor to tell who will marry who. Everyone becomes curious, except Arnold who refuses to take the test, until Rhonda tells him who it might predict.

S1 E10 — Dog Dish / Watch DogUsing a time travel watch, Dudley tries to go back to the past to outwit Kitty for the last doughnut left in the T.U.F.F. snack room. // Dudley's forced to wear an amplified sound neck cone to keep from scratching his butt.
S7 E8 — Spongebob's Last StandSpongeBob and Patrick protest the construction of a highway that would destroy Jellyfish Fields.

S5 E19 — Taste Buddies!When Chefs Molly & Gil bring their food truck to Bland Land, they discover that the Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread! The Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom!

S5 E20 — Fogzilla!It's Lighthouse Keeper Deema's birthday! But when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she must figure out how to get Captain Molly's ship to shore, or there won't be a party!
S2 E12 — Ruby Tart / SmoothiesOn Ruby Day, Chef's usual traditions-like making a Ruby Tart-go all wrong. / Chef and Olly want to make smoothies, but Henry won't let them inside the Stump!
S4 E5 — Learn To Be QuietCol does not know how to stay quiet, distracting Monti from his schoolwork. Gardener Tim shows him how to do this by telling him the story of the Magician of Silence.

S8 E11 — The Snow, Sea, Sky, RaceBlaze and Crusher face off in an off-road showdown: the Snow, Sea, Sky Race! The trucks must speed through the snow, swim through the sea, and soar to a finish line in the sky!

Eighteen-year-old Mary Stuart attempts to reclaim her rightful place on the English throne, overthrowing her cousin Elizabeth I, and finds herself condemned to years of imprisonment before facing execution.
In 19th-century France, ex-prisoner Jean Valjean, pursued for many years by ruthless policeman Javert, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.

The turbulent life story of blind music genius Ray Charles. Ray's audacity and groundbreaking talent made him a phenomenon on the road and in the studio, but drugs, women and bad memories took a heavy toll on his personal life.
A musical tale in which a young blue-collar worker attempts to escape from his dead-end Detroit life by competing in rapping competitions, but he can only make it if he holds his nerve.

After being suspended, Jesse Stone starts to work for an old friend; he investigates a series of murders in Boston and discovers a link to an infamous gangster.

Erin Brockovich, a struggling single mum exposes a powerful utility company for dumping deadly toxic waste that is slowly poisoning the local residents. Employed as a filing clerk in her lawyer's firm, the former beauty queen stumbles across this landmark case that transforms her into a working-class hero.
A former LAPD officer and recovering alcoholic investigates the suspicious death of a young friend, while the local police force deals with the arrogant new police chief.

When a reporter in pursuit of a Washington sex scandal is arrested by the FBI, she discovers that the story is an inconsequential part of a huge cover-up. She soon finds herself in possession of the biggest story in the history of humankind.

A giant shark is feeding on the good people of Amity Island, and it's up to police chief Martin Brody to hunt down the finned fiend.

p.t: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
p.d: When an ancient emperor's tomb is discovered in the 1940s, Rick O'Connell and his wife become involved in a plot to restore the emperor to power.

On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.
On a camping trip, the all-American Henderson family run over the legendary Bigfoot. Taking him home to suburbia was a mistake though: he's loveable, but he's a seven-foot wrecking ball.

Searching for a safer habitat, the prehistoric Crood family discover an idyllic paradise. Unfortunately, they must also learn to live with the Bettermans, an advanced clan who are a few steps above the Croods on the evolutionary ladder.
After an aptitude test mix-up, Fred Flintstone is promoted. An evil executive, however, plots to use Fred in an embezzlement scheme.

When the Primm family move to New York City, their young son, Josh, struggles to adapt to his new school and new friends. All of that changes when he meets Lyle, a singing crocodile who loves baths, caviar, and great music.
A grouchy ogre and his jabbering donkey sidekick set out to rescue an imprisoned princess from a scheming lord.
Shrek faces his greatest challenge yet: the in-laws. Shrek and Princess Fiona return from their honeymoon to find an invitation to visit Fiona's parents, the King and Queen of Far, Far Away.
Shrek and friends set out to find Fiona's slacker cousin, Artie, and bring him back to rule the land of Far, Far Away.
Shrek makes a deal with an embittered Rumpelstiltskin that lands him in an alternate reality where he was never born, and faces a race against time to break the spell and rescue Fiona.
Ian Malcolm reluctantly returns to an island off Costa Rica's coast where cloned dinosaurs are flourishing.
Flip the ignition and prepare for a brand-new episode of Caught On Dashcam. From nail-biting near misses to encounters with things that go bump in the night, we’ve got it all caught on camera!
Jim leads a raid on a suspected drug dealer, Dan and Gordy respond to a violent alleyway attack, and Jon goes on the hunt for a serial frugal driver.
A fleeing suspect tries every excuse to get out of going to jail. A driver asks deputies to hide the truth from his wife. A trespassing call becomes a neighbourhood-wide ordeal.
Featuring police officers in cities across the US, patrolling streets for car thieves, drug pushers, sex-trade workers, violent thugs and anyone else who dares step onto the wrong side of the law.
Sergeants pull over a driver for failing to put on his headlights, but the driver takes a vow of silence on the advice of his passenger and refuses to say anything. A car runs a red light.
Tobacco is the most trafficked commodity in the world. Australian Border Force join with Victoria Police to bust an unsuspecting criminal syndicate bringing in millions of cigarettes illegally.
With 3 million young drivers using the country's roads, it's a round the clock challenge for the Traffic Cops to keep them in check.

A young Dad suddenly suffers frightening seizures while driving his wife and baby. Aaron and Laura treat a serial daredevil with serious injuries after a spectacular crash on his dirt bike, and Chris and Sam play “word of the day”.

Two conspiracy-obsessed men kidnap the CEO of a major company when they become convinced that she's an alien who wants to destroy Earth.
A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbour is pitted against neighbour in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes, celebrate the birth of their son, Hamnet. However, when tragedy strikes and Hamnet dies at a young age, it inspires Shakespeare to write his timeless masterpiece "Hamlet.".
Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.
Kristin Harila risked everything to summit the world's 14 highest peaks at record speed. When her final ascent sparked backlash, her greatest triumph became a reckoning.
The true story of seasoned deep-sea divers who battle the raging elements to rescue a crewmate who's trapped hundreds of feet below the ocean's surface.

The Crawley family goes on a grand journey to the South of France to uncover the mystery of the dowager countess's newly inherited villa.
An ousted sports agent attempts to rebuild his career with the help of a loyal accountant and an egotistical athlete.

p.d: An advice columnist attempts to make a man dump her in 10 days, but he makes a bet with his boss that he will make her fall in love with him.

Two energy drink salesmen play the role of big brothers to fulfil a community service obligation, which quickly becomes a pint-sized hassle as they learn kids can be unpredictable.

Two years after M3GAN's rampage, Gemma must revive her creation to stop Emilia, a rogue military AI growing too self-aware to control.

TAPS travels to Alabama to investigate Sloss Furnaces, a 50-acre industrial plantoperating from 1882 until the 1970s.
The Ghost Hunters enlist the help of Bravo's The Real Housewives of Atlanta as they embark on this week's investigation.
The Christmas Farm Inn in Jackson, N.H., and the Old Stone Fort in Schoharie, N.Y., are probed.

The TAPS crew is summoned to the city of Alexandria, Louisiana, by residents claiming that they have a haunted hotel, tavern and restaurant that need to be investigated; the town hosts an event for the ghost hunters to submit their findings.

The crew investigates the infamous Pennhurst Asylum in Pennsylvania, which is said to have a section in which ghosts can be heard playing the piano and a tunnel system where visions of dismembered torsos and a female ghost have been seen.
TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions to shadow figures.
TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint.
TAPS is in Rapid City, South Dakota- at the foot of Mount Rushmore- investing the Hotel Alex Johnson. This place is so freaky that contractors have walked off the job and refused to return.
TAPS heads to Mission Point Resort on Mackinac Island. Constructed in the 1950's as a summer destination, it becomes nearly deserted in the winter time, and perfect for the team to investigate.

The TAPS team travels to a Civil War fort in Maine in order to explore claims of an evil presence that resides within its walls, and they later head to a home in North Carolina to investigate the sounds and physical contact that plague a family.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor.
Ghost Hunters, Tapsheads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House.

For the first time ever, TAPS travels to Hawaii to explore one of America's most sacred settings, Pearl Harbor. They are joined in their investigation of the Pacific Aviation Museum by Destination Truth's Josh Gates.
We pick were we last left off, in Hawaii, for the reveal. Jason and Grant were called back for a very important personal case, the Reid House, in Rhode Island, to help a scared 4 year old.

The TAPS team has been called out to investigate Hill View Manor in New Castle, Pennsylvania. Once a nursing facility, this now abandoned building is fraught with paranormal activity that allegedly stems from the violent deaths of former patients.

p.d: Come across two lizards in Queensland that have extraordinary camouflage skills. Hold on tight as a Tasmanian devil joey faces a life-or-death situation, then try to stay calm as Tim delivers a rundown of his five favorite Aussie spiders.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Pay an emergency visit to the reptile park’s veterinarian and see what’s wrong with a massive, 6-metre-long reticulated python. Then accompany Tim on a morning feed and discover how varied the diets of the animals in the park are.

Chris is still in Cairns at Marlin Coast Vet Clinic. First up, Chris is called to a local crocodile park to treat Ted, a 5.4 metre monster with savage wounds to his snout after coming off second best.
Explores some gorgeous secret country gardens in Australia, including a natural sunken paradise, a French love affair, Red Cow Farm, and a stunning tropical garden.
Australia's most celebrated patissier Adriano Zumbo will put 12 of the country's most passionate dessert makers to the test. They will be joined by Rachel Khoo.
Guests travel to Mikey and Shay's suburban mansion in West Pennant Hills Sydney, the final instant hotel of the series. Guests are surprised to learn that they must look after the pets as well.

After losing half his body weight, a diabetic Maltese terrier is placed on a drip; a ring-necked parakeet suffering from shock refuses to eat or drink; a wheaten terrier is brought to the clinic in dire need of a blood transfusion.
Its the big day of the casting and Maria surprises Lorinska and Rachel by arriving unannounced. Which baby will win the casting?

Jamie's new series aims to inspire aspiring cooks and show them what they can achieve in 15 minutes. On the menu are sizzling beef steak, hoi sin prawn, noodle bowls, mackeral and quinoa salad.
Gordon shows how to cook with chilli. Recipes include red mullet with sweet chilli sauce, classic jerk chicken, and a super simple spicy beef salad.

Delve into the depths of truffle exploration in the village of Sorges with Justine. Experience the tasting, hunting, and authentic ways to savour the earthy flavour.
Maeve seeks out the deeply satisfying carbohydrate staples at the heart of many of the great dishes of the world. In this episode, Indian, Italian, Lebanese, and Cuban recipes are the stars.
This episode is packed with irresistible treats! Kirsten unveils the secrets to a perfect sponge cake and whips up baked apples, buttery fudge shortbreads and creamy maritozzi buns.

Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall is headed to Australia to anoint an Aussie worthy of carrying on the River Cottage tradition, Paul West. In this episode the pair will face uniquely Australian challenges and characters.

p.d: Kirstie and Phil help Karol and Richard in St Osyth. Karol wants to list their dated bungalow; Richard wants to renovate. Can Kirstie make them love it, or will Phil find a new home for them?
After a second chance drawing, a couple wins a whopping $250,000 on an original losing ticket! Now, David is challenged to find a spacious home fit for their growing family.
After years in apartments, a family wins $4 million and can finally buy a home. David searches for one with a yard, laundry and little luxuries.
California transplants look for a simpler small-town feel in Laurel. Ben and Erin present them with two home options, and the one they choose gives Erin a few design surprises along the way.

Following the nurses of Queen Alexandra Hospital in Portsmouth as they work across multiple areas of the hospital treating both male and female patients from a range of age groups.

p.t: Kirstie & Phil's Love It or List It
p.d: This time, Phil is catching up with Carol and Andrew from Harrogate who we first met in 2016 when they were at loggerheads over their beautiful 3-bed semi-detached property.

The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride's territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Ava's survival skills are still intact.

The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. It's time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it's not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It's actually a diver's paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom.

Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poacher's snare. Meanwhile, the center's resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery.

Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Aurora's cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzie's game-changing research in jeopardy.

Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones, from a ring-tailed lemur who learns everything from its mom to a tiny orangutan that receives a constant supply of motherly cuddles.

This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that won't go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks she's a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

p.t: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil
p.d: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials' mealtime.

p.t: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil
p.d: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the country's marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. They're committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young.

Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks.

Explore the urban jungle with Hope, who is on a mission to learn more about wildlife behaviour in a giant metropolis. Grab a flashlight and prowl moonlit city streets as she searches for a mysterious nocturnal predator.

When Hope suddenly sustains an injury, life at the rehabilitation center must continue as normal without her being there; an artist draws inspiration from Hope for Wildlife; an owl receives a malevolent welcome back to the wildlife.

Get a first impression of Courtney, the new boarder, as Tammy and Allie grapple with managing the barn now that Megan has resigned. Tag along with Megan, who visits a friend in Alberta looking for greener pastures and a fresh start.

Brace for fallout as Tammy blows a gasket after Courtney is rude to Jamie and Alex. In Alberta, Megan isn't as lucky finding new employment as she'd hoped, and feels the stress as she finally decides to head home.

Explore the labour-intensive agricultural operations at the Smithsonian National Zoo. Acres of hay and bamboo are grown to help meet the needs of big eaters like the gorillas and bison, while also providing enrichment to a trio of lemurs.
Otters, siamangs and Sumatran tigers demonstrate how zoo food provides more than nutrition—it also stimulates playful behaviour that keeps animals more content.
Watch as zoo staff must focus their energy on two herds of asian elephants after one of the herds arrives from another zoo. Can food help these elephant families bond?
At the St Louis Zoo, feeding each animal has unique challenges, especially for the big eaters. See how staff feed the gorillas, an anaconda named J-Lo, cinereous vultures and the very hungry hippos.
Scott performs a surgical procedure on a cat with a fused jaw; the team makes a school visit to help goats; Scott's hairdresser questions him about his dog's issues.

An exotic dog named Paloma meets Dr. Scott and his team, who must deal with her tricky past; Bella the bulldog hopes to find her new forever home; a litter of feral kittens arrive at the clinic to receive treatment for their worms.

Cheer on Scott and Emma, who’ve fallen in love with a not-so-wild fox. Then go from happiness to heartbreak with Hugo the bull mastiff, whose rescue has worked out but whose health may be in jeopardy.

Track the progress of a five-month-old puppy who’s had emergency surgery after a freak accident. Then investigate the perplexing case of a young poodle-cross who suddenly stops being able to walk. Can Dr. Scott prevent permanent paralysis?
Dr. Brown rushes to save a policeman's pet after it was poisoned with snail bait; a malnourished penguin washes up on Bondi Beach and is brought to the clinic.

Witness a shocking act of cruelty when the vets take on a 12-year-old cat deliberately left to die in the Bondi surf. Meet a depressed parrot caught up in a bizarre love triangle and watch Lisa help a Samoyed survive a killer tick bite.

Take a lesson in responsible canine ownership when the Atkinson family taps Beverley to help them bring home a brand new puppy. Learn if a Brussels griffon, a sheltie, or a toy Manchester terrier will be the best teacher for their three kids.

Star Wars provides further fodder when Jamie and Adam see whether high ground really is important in a duel, and whether it's possible to dive out of the way of laser blaster bullets (well, a Stormtroopers', anyway).
It’s an episode of real genius, explosive action and dangerous driving. First Adam and Jamie take on the classic urban myth driving in the Rain.
Can cell phones cause dangerous gas station fires? Can a change in atmospheric pressure, experienced while flying have an effect on breast implants? And can CDs shatter in very high-speed drives?

Myths tested: Could using a phone in a thunderstorm result in being electrocuted? Could a bullet pass through a man's genitals, into a woman's abdomen, and make the woman pregnant? Can a boat be driven with its trailer still attached?

Mikey was challenged by his friends to eat six packs of POP Rocks Candy and Six cans of Soda. The carbon dioxide that makes the candy pop combined with the carbon dioxide in the soda to create so much pressure his stomach exploded.

Adam, Jamie and the build team investigate whether the Confederate Army had a secret deadly weapon. Could they really have built the world's first long-range missile when the steam engine was cutting edge?
In Mythsion Control, fans challenge Jamie's physics—testing whether two trucks colliding at 50 mph equals one hitting a wall at 100 mph or just 50 mph.
Jamie and Adam do battle with each other, while Kari Tory and Grant are consumed in a battle against mother nature
Would a sinking ship pull you under? Titanic survivors said they rowed away from the vortex, and other sailors report the same—but is it true?

Jamie Hyneman and Adam Savage find out if launching a chicken at an airplane will disrupt its flight and if a washing machine can really be deadly. They also explore the myth of the woman who swallowed an octopus egg then gave birth to an eight-legged offspring.
Brian and Jon investigate whether two arrow-themed myths fly straight and true. Can a flaming arrow fired into a car's gas tank cause it to erupt in flames?

This episode of MythBusters is a game of two halves: Kari, Grant and Tory investigate a world-famous myth from American history, while Adam and Jamie probe some rather unpleasant facts about flatulence.

Adam and Jamie reveal their favourite shopping haunts. Tune in for a comprehensive alternative shoppers guide as the Mythbusters show how they procure the weird and wonderful array of stuff they have used in the making of the show.
On this blisteringly cold episode of Mythbusters, the team gets some northern exposure as they pack up their sleds, their brass monkeys and their ingenuity for Alaska Special, The Return.
The MythBusters explore Newtonian propulsion. Can you move through syrup as efficiently as water, and can a sailboat be powered by blowing on its own sail?
Discover how lakes, rivers, and marshes are the key to thriving animal life.

As the dry season takes hold in Zambia's Luangwa Valley, lagoons will start to dry-up and verdant grasslands will gradually turn to dust. Animals must make the most of the wet season’s legacy whilst they can.

Africa’s Great Rift Valley supports an extraordinary mosaic of animals that depend on two vastly different seasons: the wet and the dry. See what animals do to survive an unforgiving dry season that’s set to last for another three months.
Africa is a tapestry of habitats that host an incredible variety of creatures and within the mighty continent are areas of exceptional natural beauty - the Great Parks of Africa.

In the Pantanal, the wonderful ocelot appears to be making a comeback. A team of scientists try to figure out the clues to its resurgence.
The white-whiskered spider monkey is one of the most intelligent and agile creatures in the New World, and dwells happily within a protected Brazilian forest.
Finding a home in new territory is a challenge, but sometimes, animals have no choice. Using sheer numbers to impose their will, these are nature's unwanted guests.

The team gates to a climate-controlled environment amidst a toxic wasteland, whose people are all linked to a central computer.

While investigating a crashed ship, SG-1 finds hundreds of inhabited pods. While counting, they are all knocked unconscious. Upon returning to SGC, Daniel insists on getting back to the ship and appears to not know where he is nor who anyone else is.

An alien proposes to share his planet's technology in exchange for Carter helping him win a space race.

SG-1 encounters a race of women warriors whose survival depends on symbiotes harvested from Jaffa. Teal'c and SG-1 must convince the warriors' high priestess to put aside her fear of reliance on a life-saving drug before the Goa'uld destroy them.

SG-1 encounters a very advanced bio-engineered warrior endowed with super strength, created by Anubis. While the team sets out to locate the origin of this new foe, Daniel travels to South America in search of a device left on Earth by the Ancients.

Having found the location of the warrior base, Carter is assigned a recon mission to determine Anubis's plans. Meanwhile, O'Neill mounts a mission to South America to rescue Daniel who has been kidnapped by Honduran rebels demanding a ransom.

While on a routine journey, the Prometheus is attacked by an alien ship and is forced to enter a mysterious interstellar cloud; Dr. Carter awakens to find herself alone on the Prometheus and begins to suffer from hallucinations.
Jonas Quinn returns with news that Naquadria mines of Kelowna will cause an explosion in the planet's core.

Daniel experiences strange dreams centered around his possible knowledge of the Lost City of the Ancients. Suspicious that Daniel's mind is being manipulated, the team must find a way to help him while keeping the secret from the Goa'uld.
When the Beta Site is attacked by Anubis's drones, Carter and Jacob get their first chance to test a new weapon. Jacob is injured and Carter goes MIA.

SG-1 SG-3 and SG-5 gate to the address where they find the nomadic tribe and Daniel Jackson. Carter convinces Daniel that he was a very good person and to return to SG-1. The team theorizes that Daniel was expelled from the race of Ascended beings by his benefactor Oma after he interfered in human affairs on Abydos.

Gloucester, Massachusetts is the oldest fishing port in the United States and for the last ten years a fleet of Gloucester blue fin tuna fishermen have overcome obstacles, survived danger, and embraced glory. But this season is their biggest test yet. With a world in flux, these fishermen fight the only way they know how; with grit, resilience, and determination. It's do or die for the blue fin and the fleet, this season on WICKED TUNA.

With limited days on the water, the captains are determined to start the season off strong. Making waves early on is Captain Dave Marciano aboard the Hard Merchandise, who seems to have found his mojo after a few disappointing seasons.
Reigning champion, Captain TJ Ott, wants to bring home the title again - but the other captains refuse to let him get ahead this early in the game.

With fewer days available to fish, each captain must find a strategy to maximize catches-and profits. While some rely on meticulously reviewing notes and coordinates from previous years, others simply trust their instincts and hope for the best. But when playing it smart doesn't necessarily mean playing it safe, does taking a bigger risk mean bringing home a bigger paycheck?

Captain Spurge Krasowski is a local legend in the Gloucester waters and no stranger to facing challenges in the bluefin industry. Though this year's obstacle is different than any other, Spurge still challenges the fleet to work hard, fish smart and push their limits like never before. But can this old schoolmaster inspire the captains enough to score big in a shaky season?

Competing against Gloucester's best team, resilient young newcomer Captain Jack Patrican has struggled to demonstrate that he has what it takes to keep up with the rest of the fleet. With this season's limited fishing schedule, every second counts, and Jack is more determined than ever to catch blue gold and prove that the Time Flies is a force to be reckoned with.

All eyes are on Wicked Pissah as the trio leads the fleet. Paul reveals the reason for their drive this year, but they're not the only ones willing to do whatever it takes to be on top. By limiting fishing days, the plan to stabilize the market is finally paying off, and a higher demand for bluefin increases prices on quality catches, taking the competition up a notch.

The seas off the coast of Gloucester are rich with bluefin, but summer storms wreak havoc on the fleet. With winds and tides running high, there's no escape from danger, and the teams know with a short window to catch, they can't afford to stay off the water. It will take helping hands and a lot of skill to make the weather work in their favor in order to get much-needed paychecks.

Even on a normal day, commercial bluefin tuna fishing comes with a whole host of challenges. But after a period of bad weather and with an upcoming buyer break, the seas are crowded with boats and competition is fierce. After a rough first half of the season catching smaller, low-quality fish, Fat Tuna will fight through it all and stop at nothing to get ahead in the competition.

In one of the toughest seasons in Wicked Tuna history when finding the fish and making a paycheck is harder than ever, can the next generation of Gloucester fishermen rise up to the challenge, battling one obstacle after another? Can these young guns of the Bluefin fishery step up their game and prove their worth by bringing home blue gold?
Hot Tuna gets help from Bad Fish to help increase profits by catching Bluefin for their family business and move out of the middle of the pack.

As the clock keeps ticking on the toughest season yet, Gloucester’s best captains must rely on their mates to help them land Bluefin in an uncertain market. But while some crews find strength in numbers, others find themselves shorthanded. And as the pressure mounts, these mates are forced to push themselves harder than ever as they fight to land blue gold and end up on top.

In a season already weighed down by less fishing days and lower prices, the fleet faces one more obstacle beyond their control: the bite slowing down. As the waters warm during summer, the Bluefin spread out, but now they’re nowhere to be found and the clock is ticking. With three days to land a paycheck, the fleet fishes from Maine all the way down to Cape Cod Bay, and the pressure to catch pushes captains to rethink their strategies.

In their 10th season as competitors, the Gloucester captains face an unprecedented challenge: making a living in a bluefin market that's struggling to rebound. The resilient fleet decides to work together OBX-style to help each other catch. The 5 original boats are joined by a familiar mix of recent captains and a tuna legend, whose skills immediately puts the entire fleet on notice.
Captain Dave Marciano defies the fleet by fishing in a secret location on his own.
